topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I just found out that my neighbor, who's always driving that old beater and complaining about every little bill, is actually swimming in money. He’s got a vault of cash, property overseas, the whole nine yards. betraying a façade of financial struggle for who knows how long. Meanwhile, I've been scrimping and saving, trying to make ends meet, and what does he do? Acts like he's in the same boat, all while lining his pockets. It’s a new low, even for him. I can’t believe I fell for it, but I won’t be fooled again.
